breaking_news.headline: Meta plans to release AI-powered prediction market app, documents show
breaking_news.summary: The company is building an app separate from Facebook and Instagram where people can wager on the outcome of real-world events, using "play money."

breaking_news.headline: World Cup fans are missing games after their resale tickets fall through
breaking_news.summary: The ordeal has left fans forced to either miss out on a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity or scramble to find new tickets, often costing more and for worse seats.

breaking_news.headline: This mindset shift can help you get better at using up your leftovers
breaking_news.summary: Don't let your leftovers go to waste. Cookbook authors share clever storage techniques — like an "Eat Me First" box in your fridge — and cooking tricks to help you make the most of your food scraps.

breaking_news.headline: Red, white and glowing blue: Trump's push for new reactors reaches the finish line
breaking_news.summary: A program initiated by the Trump administration has allowed small companies to rush their testing of several new nuclear reactor designs. Some worry that safety is being compromised.

breaking_news.headline: Supreme Court cements Trump's power over agencies long considered independent
breaking_news.summary: In a 6-3 decision, the Supreme Court struck down a 91-year-old precedent that has prevented presidents from removing members of independent agencies meant to be a check on his power.

breaking_news.headline: Computer scientist on why he believes mass layoffs due to AI is a 'convenient excuse'
breaking_news.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep asks Princeton computer scientist Sayash Kapoor about his assertions that AI won't lead to mass layoffs.

breaking_news.headline: Tricks to help you spend less money at restaurants
breaking_news.summary: Personal finance and nutrition experts share simple strategies that make it possible to eat out without spending a fortune. One tip? You might have to let go of your fast food delivery habit.

breaking_news.headline: Meta considered buying Kalshi before developing its own prediction market app
breaking_news.summary: Mark Zuckerberg met with Kalshi's CEO last year about a potential deal, but talks did not move forward. Now Meta is making its own prediction market app.

breaking_news.headline: Sudan's RSF committed crimes against humanity in el-Fasher, Amnesty says
breaking_news.summary: The Amnesty report adds to evidence of atrocities in el-Fasher, which the UN says bore the hallmarks of genocide.

breaking_news.headline: Three-year-old rescued and taken to hospital six days after Venezuela quake
breaking_news.summary: Video footage shows rescuers cheering as the child is pulled from rubble in La Guaira state.

breaking_news.headline: Man guilty of attempted murder of three children in Dublin
breaking_news.summary: Riad Bouchaker denied attempting to murder three children and assaulting four other people on 23 November 2023.

breaking_news.headline: A plane crashed into a tower in Beijing but China is not saying what happened
breaking_news.summary: The collision left holes on the side of the tower, but Beijing has scrubbed other visible traces of the incident.

breaking_news.headline: Fire kills five at Antwerp apartment block
breaking_news.summary: A man was seen clambering through a window to escape black smoke in the block where some 200 people live.

breaking_news.headline: Three die in Mexico City World Cup celebrations
breaking_news.summary: More than one million people took to the streets of Mexico City on Tuesday to mark the country's win over Ecuador.

breaking_news.headline: Controversial bishops ordained as Pope warns of 'schism' in Catholic Church
breaking_news.summary: Thousands of worshippers attended a ceremony in the Swiss Alps as part of the breakaway Society of Saint Pius X.

breaking_news.headline: 'Time for him to pay' - Carroll calls on Trump to pay $5m after president's appeal fails
breaking_news.summary: The writer's lawyers say Trump wants to delay paying the damages awarded by a jury that found the president liable for sexually abusing and defaming her.

breaking_news.headline: Australia sues Amazon for making allegedly unfair contracts with subscribers
breaking_news.summary: The Australian Competition and Consumer Commission (ACCC) says Amazon has broken consumer protection law

breaking_news.headline: Anthropic says US lifts export ban on its advanced AI tools
breaking_news.summary: Fable and Mythos were abruptly suspended in June over concerns that they could be used by hackers.

breaking_news.headline: Why is crucial tech vulnerable to the heat?
breaking_news.summary: Energy grids and train services are among the vital services that are vulnerable to very hot weather.

breaking_news.headline: Why Gen Z are planning for life without a state pension
breaking_news.summary: Many younger people do not believe the state pension will exist when they are older
